parameters.name: AddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the address pool. You can call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspools) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The number of consecutive health checks.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

sub_parameters.name: CityCode
sub_parameters.description: The city code of the monitoring node.

sub_parameters.name: IspCode
sub_parameters.description: The carrier code of the monitoring node.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. The parameters vary based on the protocol type.

- HTTP or HTTPS

  - port: The health check port.

  - host: The Host header.

  - path: The URL path.

  - code: The health check is considered abnormal if the returned HTTP status code is greater than this value.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - sni: Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is used only when the health check protocol is HTTPS. Valid values:

    - true

    - false

  - nodeType: The type of the monitoring node. This parameter is used when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- PING

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - packetNum: The number of ping packets.

  - packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the monitoring node. This parameter is used when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- TCP

  - port: The health check port.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the monitoring node. This parameter is used when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

> This parameter must be a JSON string.

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- PING

- TCP
